name: IC Driver Motor — 3.3V, I2C — MSOP
description: Motor driver IC cluster with 3.3V operating voltage and I2C communication in surface-mount MSOP-8 and MSOP-10 footprints.
selection_hints: Choose between MSOP-8 (0.65mm pitch) and MSOP-10 (0.5mm pitch) options based on required pin count.
Select EMC2301-x-ACZL for MSOP-8 footprint or EMC2302-x-AIZL for MSOP-10 footprint.
Verify that 3.3V operating voltage and I2C interface fit the design requirement.
avoid_when: The board layout requires a package family other than MSOP.
The application requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
The required bus interface is not I2C or operating voltage is not 3.3V.
